brief: A ring of golden sparks in the dark trembling as a branch cracks somewhere far; the Vetāla speaking softly to them with an open hand; you kneeling beside the smallest spark with Dādī's hand on your shoulder; Śuka close against your arm.

The small servant spirit crouched by the fire cooking in a little clay pot, one hand stirring, a thin smile; Dādī watching; Śuka sniffing the steam; the Vetāla in the background with an amused expression.

A small stooped spirit in a patched servant's wrap shuffling into the firelight with an empty tray, baffled; the Vetāla pointing a lazy finger at him; Dādī explaining with two raised hands, one pointing away and one curling back to herself; Śuka cocking his head.

An old grove at night at the edge of a burning ground: a śiṃśapā tree with a long, thin ash-grey spirit hanging upside down from a branch, eyes closed, arms folded; below, you, Dādī and Śuka looking up; far back among the trunks the faint glow of a lantern and the tall silhouette of Lubdhaka; a tiny bright-red spirit pointing a long finger.

Lubdhaka stepping out from between tree trunks with a raised lantern and a thin smile; the Vetāla hanging above him with a sweetly polite expression and a hand extended in welcome; Dādī gripping Śuka who stares with his beak open; long shadows.

Lubdhaka setting a heavy leather purse on a tree root before you, his other hand on his satchel; the Vetāla grinning upside down; you standing firm with Dādī's hand on your shoulder and Śuka fluffed up; lantern light and long shadows.

The burning-ground grove at night: a slim spirit of pale morning light leaning forward as if about to run, hair streaming ahead; the Vetāla hanging above with a sly look; you, Dādī and Śuka in the foreground; a glow of dawn beginning at the far edge of the trees.

A tiny perfectly round smooth white stone spirit rolled up to your feet at the foot of the śiṃśapā tree, patting itself as if looking for a place to attach something; the Vetāla hanging above, smiling; Dādī and Śuka looking down; firelight on the smooth stone.
